edits.current: xml - the file is an XML document named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml, where cc = 01 for an insertion or 02 for a replacement, mmmmm = the format code 02276, vv = the version 04, aaaa = the year (four digits) and cccccccc = the consecutive file number. Each file carries at most 5,000 records; a population above 5,000 beneficiaries is sent in several files distinguished by the consecutive number (DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4, Res. 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1, entry T3.45).

Each file carries at most 5,000 records; a population above 5,000 beneficiaries is sent in several files distinguished by the consecutive number (DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4, Res. 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1, entry T3.45).

edits.current: - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself prescribes no XSD: the element names, ordering and lengths are fixed by the technical specifications of Format 2276 version 4, so every element path in this specification is a logical name marked DERIVED, mapped to the element names of the published technical specifications. The physical file is an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year, cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file.
